errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста X са разположени на всеки две години, започвайки от 2008 и завършвайки на 2018.
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are present for every year from 2008 to 2018, not every two years.
The full label for the Y-axis is 'Производителност на труда, хил.лв на заето лице', but the description omits the final part 'на заето лице' (per employed person).
The description incorrectly states that the blue line has square markers, but the figure shows it has circular markers.
The orange line is described as 'пунктирана' (dotted), but it is a dashed line.
The description incorrectly states that the value for the orange line decreases from 2008 to 2009. The value actually increases from 30.758 to 34.300.

errors.text_span: след което се понижава до 48.079 през 2014 г.
errors.evidence: This statement misrepresents the trough for the orange line. While the value does decrease to 48.079 in 2014, the actual lowest point in this period is 46.466 in 2015, which is not mentioned.
